name: pict-provider-progress
description: Unified operation progress, event-logging and outcome reporting for the Retold ecosystem: a dependency-free core that turns a phased-operation state (Fable Operation / ProgressTracker shape) into a display model with per-phase and whole-operation percent + ETA, plus a Pict provider that polls and normalizes it for a UI.

scripts.coverage: npx nyc --reporter=text --reporter=html mocha -u tdd -R spec --exit test/*_tests.js
